title: Hand Contract: Powder for the Hand
summary: The Hand is buying gunpowder. Nobody asks what for.

dialogue.intro: A note sealed with a golden hand: 'Powder. Sixteen measures. Don't ask.'
offer: The villager shrugs. 'Nobody asks. That's why they pay.'
dialogue.return: The Hand still wants its powder.
dialogue.reward: The powder's gone before you've let go of it. Your purse is fuller.
dialogue.done: Something will burn soon. Not your problem.
